name: Kimi dake no Botedol! ~Hakudaku Mamire no Tenshi~
original_name: 君だけのボテドル！～白濁まみれの天使～
source:
You're a music producer. Your current job is to produce an idol group. However, the members are all pregnant girls....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
